Moss's notes mention two Quarrendon Freight Lines (QFL) tickets:

1. **#PD-4492.** This comes from Moss's "Sunday prep for Ruth" digest dated 5 Oct 2025 (`teams/team-north/digests/2025-10-05-north-sunday.md`). Thea Ramaswell logged it on 4 Oct 2025. Drivers at the Eau Claire yard (Dock Doors 14–18, 04:00 shift) weren't getting SMS bay assignments when they checked in at the gatehouse kiosk. Support patched it that evening, and Thea confirmed it was fixed on 5 Oct.
2. **#4419.** This comes from Moss's undated "North cheat sheet" (`teams/team-north/digests/north-account-cheatsheet.md`). Thea logged it because gatehouse barcode scanners weren't reading trailer tags at Door 14 during the third shift. It was escalated to tier-2 product support for scanner firmware testing. The note doesn't say whether it was resolved.

Some ticket numbers in Moss's notes look related but aren't QFL tickets:
- **#4409 and #4412** in the Central handoffs digest (2 Jan 2026) are on Pree's dealer account (Marrow Fieldworks handoff), not QFL.
- **FR-882** in the same digest is a Marrow Agrisupply feature request.
- Moss's other QFL notes (the 14 Sep 2025 pipeline digest and the 23 Mar 2026 renewal note) don't give any ticket numbers.
- Marcus's note on "Quarendon Freightways" (one R) is about a different company that isn't our customer, so I left it out.

I only checked notes you can open yourself. There's a QFL incident channel (#inc-qfl-sev1), but you're not a member, so I didn't look there. If you need incident tickets for the deck, Dana Okafor or Ilse Varga can tell you what's in it.
